description: This Dart source file defines the NewsAppState class, which manages application state for a news app in Flutter. It handles loading saved news articles, fetching news categories from an API, managing saved articles, and notifying listeners of state changes.

classes.name: NewsAppState
classes.description: Manages the application's news data, loading from database, fetching from network, and notifying UI components of updates.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes app state by loading saved news and fetching categories.

methods.name: articlesFor
methods.description: Returns list of articles for a specific category.

methods.name: topHeadlines
methods.description: Retrieves top headlines from 'general' category based on configured count.

methods.name: generalDownList
methods.description: Returns list of 'general' articles excluding top headlines.

methods.name: refreshCategory
methods.description: Fetches latest articles for a specified category from network.

methods.name: _fetchCategory
methods.description: Internal method to perform category-specific fetch and store results.

methods.name: isSaved
methods.description: Checks if an article with the given headline is saved.

methods.name: saveArticle
methods.description: Saves or updates an article in the local database and updates saved list.

methods.name: deleteSavedByHeadline
methods.description: Deletes a saved article identified by its headline.
